title: CAI Content Credentials is affected by a Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm vulnerability that could…
description: CAI Content Credentials suffers from a vulnerability involving the use of a broken or risky cryptographic algorithm. This flaw could allow an attacker to bypass security features and gain unauthorized write access without requiring user interaction. Exploitation depends on conditions beyond the attacker's control. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.9.
